mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId, reply_count AS replyCount FROM ( SELECT id, parent_id, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id) AS reply_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC) AS reply_position FROM comment WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND status = 1 AND parent_id IN #{rootId} ) ranked WHERE reply_position <= 2 ORDER BY parent_id, reply_position
